subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: A genuine statement whose authorization header has typ, alg, kid and b64 false and no crit, with a signature that verifies under O over RFC 7797's signing input (the base64url of the header, a full stop, the statement), then a genuine attestation at 4: R6.37 shapes a detached signature with crit exactly [b64], so the row is act-signature-invalid. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
